name: Indian Nationals 2020

venue.name: SRM Institute of Science and Technology

information:
# The competition has been cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak.

This is the Indian National Championship. Competitors of all countries can receive prizes. However, only Indians can win titles and medals.


April 23, 2020 (Day 0) is for conducting staff rounds. Participants will be allowed to enrol themselves as competition staff and the final list of staff members will be made available(through email) to those who have been enrolled and confirmed by the organization team. 
A staff enrolment form will be made available soon for anyone to apply for volunteering during the competition.
